def blockpos(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(16,25) for c in range(17,43) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    if not pts: return None
    cs=[p[1] for p in pts]; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
print("block:", blockpos(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':25}])
print("after click ML:", blockpos(current_frame), last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
from collections import Counter
def tilemaj(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return Counter(a[r][c] for r in range(r0,r0+3) for c in range(c0,c0+3)).most_common(1)[0][0]
